packageJson.description: The email inbox API for AI agents. Send, receive, reply, and manage threaded email conversations programmatically.
packageJson.author: AgentMail <support@agentmail.cc>

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && node -e "const https=require('https'),fs=require('fs');const download=(f)=>new Promise((res,rej)=>https.get('https://docs.agentmail.to/'+f,r=>r.statusCode===200?r.pipe(fs.createWriteStream('dist/'+f)).on('finish',res).on('error',rej):rej(new Error(f+': HTTP '+r.statusCode))).on('error',rej));Promise.all(['llms.txt'].map(download)).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});"
